AL and extensions: the safe add-on model

takeaways: AL is Microsoft's language for Business Central, and extensions keep custom work separate from the base application so updates do not turn into major rebuilds.
Tables, pages, table and page extensions, codeunits, triggers and event subscribers each have one job, and shared business rules belong in a codeunit.
AL development happens in Visual Studio Code with the AL language extension, testing belongs in a sandbox, and Git keeps a history of every change.
hook: Business Central covers standard processes, but sooner or later a company needs an extra field, approval step or business rule. In this Knowledge Nugget Mirko Peters explains for beginners and functional consultants how AL and extensions customize Business Central safely without touching the base application.
